INPUT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Input request timeout in seconds. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 120).

BROWSER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT.description: Browser launch timeout in seconds. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 300).

BACKGROUND_SCANNING.description: Enable background scanning when disconnected. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: True).

USE_GATEWAYS_AS_TIMERSERVERS.description: Assume service gateways function as timeservers. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: False).

FALLBACK_TIMESERVERS.description: List of fallback timeservers separated by commas.

FALLBACK_NAMESERVERS.description: List of fallback nameservers separated by commas.

DEFAULT_AUTO_CONNECT_TECHNOLOGIES.description: List of technologies marked autoconnectable by default. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: ethernet,wifi,cellular).

PREFERRED_TECHNOLOGIES.description: List of preferred technologies separated by commas.

NETWORK_INTERFACE_BLACKLIST.description: List of blacklisted network interfaces separated by commas. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: vmnet,vboxnet,virbr,ifb,ve-,vb-).

ALLOW_HOSTNAME_UPDATES.description: Allow ConnMan to change the system hostname. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: True).

ALLOW_DOMAINNAME_UPDATES.description: Allow ConnMan to change the system domainname. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: True).

SINGLE_CONNECTED_TECHNOLOGY.description: Keep only a single connected technology at any time. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: False).

TETHERING_TECHNOLOGIES.description: List of technologies for which tethering is allowed. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: wifi,bluetooth,gadget).

PERSISTENT_TETHERING_MODE.description: Restore earlier tethering status when returning from offline mode. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: False).

ENABLE_6TO4.description: Automatically enable Anycast 6to4 if possible. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: False).

ONLINE_CHECK_MODE.description: Online HTTP-based Internet reachability check mode. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: one-shot).

ENABLE_ONLINE_CHECK.description: Enable online HTTP-based Internet reachability check. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: True).

ONLINE_CHECK_IPV4_URL.description: URL used during online status check for IPv4. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: http://ipv4.connman.net/online/status.html).

ONLINE_CHECK_IPV6_URL.description: URL used during online status check for IPv6. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: http://ipv6.connman.net/online/status.html).

ONLINE_CHECK_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for TCP connection to online check host in seconds. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 0).

ONLINE_CHECK_INITIAL_INTERVAL.description: Initial interval between online check requests in seconds. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 1).

ONLINE_CHECK_MAX_INTERVAL.description: Max interval between online check requests in seconds. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 12).

ENABLE_ONLINE_TO_READY_TRANSITION.description: Enable continuous online reachability checks to detect loss of connectivity. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: False).

ONLINE_CHECK_FAILURES_THRESHOLD.description: Number of failed online checks before marking service as failed. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 6).

ONLINE_CHECK_SUCCESSES_THRESHOLD.description: Number of successful online checks to clear service as failed. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 6).

ONLINE_CHECK_INTERVAL_STYLE.description: Style for computing time between online check requests. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: geometric).

ALWAYS_CONNECTED_TECHNOLOGIES.description: List of technologies with AutoConnect=true always connected.

AUTO_CONNECT_ROAMING_SERVICES.description: Enable auto connection of services in roaming. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: False).

ADDRESS_CONFLICT_DETECTION.description: Enable address conflict detection. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: False).
